title: Warm Uruguayan Bean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Uruguay, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: dissolved in 2 tablespoons of warm water

instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the roasted beef strips and cook until browned.
Add the canned red kidney beans, tomato paste mixture, and 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
